title: Eisei Meijin
overview:
A Practical, Authentic Shogi Program for All Shogi Lovers, Fittingly Named "Eisei Meijin."

Historic game records of Edo-period masters, a move prediction feature, a tsume shogi solving feature, mouse support (sold separately) and more - everything pursues authentic play. No one should talk about shogi without knowing "Eisei Meijin."

すべての愛棋家に贈る実戦的本格将棋ソフト、その名も「永世名人」。

歴史に残る江戸時代の名人棋譜データや予測読み機能、詰め将棋の解答機能、マウス(別売)対応など全てが本格的対局を追求。
「永世名人」を知らずして将棋を語るべからず。
